result.title: LC-ISP Benchmark: Learning Advanced ISP with Live and Capture Streams
result.summary: High-quality paired RAW-to-sRGB datasets are essential for data-driven ISP, yet existing datasets often rely on cross-device collection, causing misalignment and failing to faithfully reflect real capture conditions. We therefore introduce LC-ISP, a large-scale benchmark built from the intrinsic gap between a camera's live preview and offline capture streams. LC-ISP contains 53.9k spatially aligned groups, each comprising live RAW/live sRGB and multi-frame fused RGB/capture sRGB, and covers day, night, indoor, outdoor, and HDR scenes. It also provides capture-stream intermediates for modular supervision. We further develop a compact two-stage baseline that uses these intermediates as auxiliary targets. Under a 2.5-GFLOP budget for 448$\times$448 RAW inputs, it outperforms the strongest single-frame baseline by over 2 dB PSNR while improving texture, denoising, and color reproduction. LC-ISP supports realistic benchmarking, the design of supervision strategies, and the development of lightweight ISP models.

AI.brief_summary: 该文构建 LC-ISP 大规模 RAW-to-sRGB 基准，利用相机预览流与拍照流之间的固有声画差异生成 53.9k 空间对齐数据组，并提供中间结果作为模块化监督，配套一个轻量两阶段 ISP 基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文聚焦低层图像信号处理的数据集与画质指标（PSNR、去噪、色彩还原），不涉及内部推理状态、视觉证据筛选或停止决策，与 latent visual reasoning 及 VLM 推理主线缺少实质联系；其「中间结果辅助监督」仅是通用训练技巧，未见具体可迁移线索。
